svg.aria-label: Client (in focus): Creates and follows links. Load balancer (in focus): Distributes requests. API servers (in focus): Shortener API and redirect. Cache (context): Holds active mappings. Link store (context): Durable code mappings. Replicas (context): Copies across zones. ID allocator (context): Reserves unique ID blocks. Hash candidate (context): Truncated URL hash. Click queue (added) (in focus): Buffers redirect events. Stable event ID for deduplication. Count store (added) (in focus): Aggregated clicks. Flow: API servers to Load balancer: Return 302 promptly. Load balancer to Client: Relay redirect. API servers to Click queue: Publish click event. Click queue to Count store: Aggregate by code.
